response.overview: When Ashley Bennet brings her friends, Sarah and Amy, along on a babysitting job, she expected that the night would be a little more exciting. But nothing could possibly have prepared her for the intense and frightful journey that she would endure inside the Barker house.  When the power goes out late in the evening, Ashley starts hearing voices resonating through the house. She is told, very bluntly, by the young girl she is babysitting that it's all in her head and she convinces Ashley to deal with it.  She tried, but the voices become louder, her friends disappear and she begins to think that her teacher is in the house with her and that he's trying to kill her. Everyone she tells thinks she's crazy, but, somehow, no one can prove her wrong.  You see, Ashley always thought she was in control of her fears. But it wasn't until she spent the night in Parkwood Hills, when she realized that it's her fears that were in control.
response.tagline: It's your fear that will be in control.
response.title: Parkwood Hills
